instruction:
Two-software CAE flow: SolidWorks -> Abaqus/CAE. No init file is provided; start from a new blank SolidWorks part.

Chain evidence requirement: use the design token EW_SW_ABQ_01. Keep this token encoded in the SolidWorks part/custom properties or STEP export metadata so the text of stage1_geometry.step contains EW_SW_ABQ_01 and SOLIDWORKS_TO_ABAQUS. In Abaqus/CAE, create at least one model, part, instance, set, surface, job description, or other native name containing both EW_SW_ABQ_01 and IMPORTED_FROM_stage1_geometry.step, so the final CAE file carries evidence that Abaqus consumed the SolidWorks STEP handoff.

1. In SolidWorks, use sketch and feature tools to create a cantilever mounting bracket. Geometry requirements: a 100 mm x 40 mm x 8 mm base plate; a 40 mm x 50 mm x 8 mm upright plate at one end; two triangular ribs; and four D6 through mounting holes in the base plate. Export the completed CAD geometry to C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_geometry.step.
2. In Abaqus/CAE, import stage1_geometry.step and create the finite-element model. Use the model name Model-Bracket. Define material Steel with E=210000 MPa and nu=0.3, create a solid section using Steel, and assign it to the bracket. Create a Static General analysis step named Step-Load. Create sets named FIXED_HOLES and LOAD_HOLE. Use a coarse global seed and mesh the bracket with first-order linear solid elements, using C3D8R where practical or coarse C3D4 where needed; do not use quadratic elements. Create a boundary condition named BC-FixedHoles that constrains FIXED_HOLES. Create a load named Load-Vertical500N that applies an approximately -500 N vertical force at LOAD_HOLE. Submit the job named Job-Bracket and wait for the analysis to complete.
3. Required deliverables on the Desktop: C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_geometry.step, C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-Bracket.cae, and C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-Bracket.odb. Do not create extra STEP, DXF, CAE, or ODB deliverables.

 First use SolidWorks to create and export the CAD STEP file, then use Abaqus/CAE to import that STEP file, build the finite-element model, submit the job, and save the CAE and ODB deliverables.
